objective: By 2026-11-30, Workspace Control can accept a substantial high-level task, recursively decompose it, route bounded work to deterministic tools, ChatGPT Instant, and subscription Codex as appropriate, execute and recover durably, validate consequential results, synthesize a final result, and account for scarce model usage without paid API fallback or weakened authority.

lanes.name: Reasoning Economy / Codex
lanes.goal: Subscription-only Codex execution, telemetry, economics accounting, calibration, and weekly allowance governor.

lanes.name: Semantic orchestration kernel
lanes.goal: Durable recursive task-tree execution, routing, waits, validation, recovery, and synthesis.

lanes.name: Instant Chat execution
lanes.goal: Production semantic work dispatched to persistent ChatGPT Instant sessions through the accepted low-attention Operator Bridge.

lanes.name: Integrated acceptance
lanes.goal: Research Engine workload proves the complete mixed-executor stack under faults and budget constraints.

requirements.requirement: Durable domain kernel covers WorkItem/ReasoningProcess/Attempt/Lease/Event/WaitCondition/RoutingDecision/ExecutorSession/ValidationResult semantics and fails closed on unknown transitions.
evidence: Production domain kernel and state-machine tests already exist; integrated real-workflow proof remains.

requirements.requirement: Recursive TOO_LARGE decomposition creates child work while preserving inherited constraints, provenance, validator contracts, authority refs, and dependency edges.
evidence: DomainKernel.decompose and dependency-wait mechanics exist; recursive integrated path remains.

requirements.requirement: TOO_LARGE/decomposable and INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT/escalation-required work are distinct durable outcomes.
evidence: Benchmark taxonomy and routing design distinguish them; production coordinated path remains.

requirements.requirement: CAS/generation fencing, leases, stale-worker rejection, retry/idempotency and multi-worker recovery work under the production kernel.
evidence: Existing runtime/fault tests cover stale generations, executor loss, duplicate events, crash boundaries and waits.

requirements.requirement: WAITING_EXTERNAL consumes zero model reasoning and resumes from durable events rather than LLM polling.
evidence: RuntimeCoordinator event-ledger wait/wake semantics exist and are tested.

requirements.requirement: Worker packets are deterministically compiled from typed durable state; routine packet construction requires no LLM.
evidence: SemanticPacketCompiler exists with canonical hashing; real vertical-slice use remains.

requirements.requirement: Executor registry is model/surface agnostic and supports deterministic, persistent-chat, machine, batch, Codex, frontier, and human profiles.
evidence: Executor profile/router model exists; integrated Instant/Codex adapters remain.

requirements.requirement: Persistent session broker safely reuses/rotates sessions and resumes from durable state after session loss.
Model output may create CandidateAction but cannot mint or widen execution authority; only authority-owned policy may produce executable ActionSpec.
evidence: DomainKernel.compile_action_spec and fail-closed authority tests exist.

requirements.requirement: Every real effect is idempotent, receipt-bound, independently postcondition-validated, and repairable without duplicate effects.
evidence: EffectReceipt, independent validation, duplicate-effect and crash-after-effect tests exist.

requirements.requirement: Workspace Control Codex runtime is live through an approved v3 control-small route while preserving PR #627 reserved-capacity invariants.
evidence: Inert bootstrap workflow and static contracts are validated; promotion is gated on PR #627 lineage.

requirements.requirement: Live authentication proves account.type=chatgpt and planType=plus with OPENAI_API_KEY absent and no paid API fallback.
Subscription-only Codex executor performs bounded jobs and returns structured JSONL-derived thread/token/tool/error telemetry.
evidence: Codex subscription adapter and trace tests exist; Workspace Control live runtime binding remains.

requirements.requirement: Controlled actions calibrate account/usage/read and rate-limit deltas; unknown allowance mappings remain explicitly unknown.
Every model attempt can produce a stable economics record with executor, usage, result, validator outcome, and known allowance delta.
evidence: Usage collector and economics ledger are validated.

requirements.requirement: Weekly burn governor projects allowance use, reserves headroom, and routes/rejects expensive work without buying credits or using API billing.
Routing promotes cheaper executors only when objective validation meets the required quality floor.
Production semantic scheduler action/status transport replaces NoWorkOperatorActionPort and the empty workload-status provider.
Normal Instant service requires only Ctrl+Space -> Ctrl+V -> Enter with no tab search, packet editing, or manual state relay.
evidence: UT-10/UT-02/UT-03/UT-04 evidence validates the accepted motor loop against fake workers.

requirements.requirement: Repeated scheduler presses before durable acknowledgment refocus/block the pending action rather than dispatch another packet.
evidence: UT-03 and prior repaired UT-01 recovery evidence passed.

requirements.requirement: First extra Ctrl+Space at READY=0 minimizes only the dedicated WorkspaceWorkers Firefox window.
evidence: UT-02 minimize-on-empty accepted by operator and structured counters.

requirements.requirement: Remaining Stage-10 trials UT-05 through UT-08, UT-12, Bridge-OFF UT-11, and representative-work UT-09 pass.
Bounded real-account Stage-12 calibration passes without expanding browser permissions, DOM/content automation, or security boundaries.
Crash/fault campaign covers durable/effect boundaries, duplicate/delayed/out-of-order events, DB disconnect, stale generations, validator timeout, and executor/session loss.
evidence: Production fault tests already cover several dangerous boundaries; database/session/full vertical-slice injection remains.

requirements.requirement: Control plane is GPU-blind and meets CPU/RAM/task budgets under the first real workflow.
A real Research Engine / research-iterate workflow completes decomposition -> routing -> executor -> validated result -> authorized low-consequence effect -> synthesis.
The proving workflow uses mixed executor classes based on routing decisions, including deterministic execution plus Instant and/or Codex.
The real workflow survives at least one worker/session/process loss without manual task-state reconstruction.
Final evidence compares scarce-allowance consumption and validated progress against an all-strong/frontier control policy.
Authoritative Operator Bridge UX-09 target performance budgets pass on the target Windows machine.
Exact SHA/blob/route provenance, authority boundaries, and rollback paths are mechanically checked with no unresolved violations.
evidence: Existing task/provenance/root-policy contracts provide the baseline; integrated promotion proof remains.

requirements.requirement: Integrated production-readiness review returns explicit PROMOTE_V0; otherwise November Integrated v0 is not complete.

schedule.exit_gate: Freeze integrated acceptance matrix; clear Codex lineage and Operator Bridge production-transport blockers; bind current code reality.
Complete orchestration integration spine: recursive task tree, session broker, event/validator services, production packet routing.
Complete Workspace Control subscription Codex live runtime/auth/executor path.
Bind real backend action/status transport to Operator Bridge and finish short Stage-10 gates.
First real Research Engine vertical slice completes end-to-end.
Recursive decomposition, mixed Instant/Codex routing, allowance calibration and weekly governor operational.
Reliability/fault-injection campaign passes on integrated stack.
Real-account Instant calibration and remaining Stage-10 acceptance pass.
Operator Bridge target performance plus representative soak/resource measurements pass.
Run full acceptance matrix and issue explicit PROMOTE_V0 or HOLD/REVISE; no scope-expanding features.

critical_path_rule: Every implementation item must close or materially advance at least one requirement ID in this matrix. Work that does not map to a requirement is out of the November critical path unless it removes a demonstrated blocker.
completion_rule: November Integrated v0 is complete only when every mandatory requirement is PASS and PROD-03 records PROMOTE_V0.
